name: sigge
description: Write copy that sounds like you, in Swedish or English. Fourteen copy frameworks, writing guides and a check for AI-writing patterns. Works without an account.

interface.longDescription: Sigge helps your assistant write copy that sounds like you, in Swedish or English. It brings fourteen copy frameworks with questions and examples, a writing guide for each language and a check for AI-writing patterns. Write a landing page, an email, an ad or a post, check a draft for AI tells, or get a copy chief review of a text you already have. Everything works without an account. A free Sigge account adds 59 perspectives and source search.
defaultPrompt: Write a landing page for our bookkeeping firm.
Check this text for AI patterns.
Review my sales email before I send it.
